open_points.subject: Pending confirmation model for a target with no revision
open_points.text: A13 rule 6 permits a confirmation bound to "that it showed none, for a record without a revision", but M11 says every pending confirmation carries "the revision or access version" and does not make that fact optional or define a no-revision value.
open_points.question: How is the revision/access-version component of a pending confirmation represented and digested when the target has no revision?
options: The component contains a distinguished no-revision sentinel.
No confirmation step may be made for such a target.
open_points.default_guess: Use a distinguished no-revision sentinel and include it unambiguously in the binding digest.

witness.initial: Project P has already been anonymised, so it remains archived but has no revision.
events: The owner asks Registry to show the confirmation step for anonymising P again.
outcomes: Registry creates a pending confirmation bound to an explicit no-revision representation, and a matching submission can return P unchanged.
Registry cannot create the M11 pending confirmation because no revision or access version exists, so it refuses or cannot show the step.
witness.observer: The owner and the agent implementing OwnerSession persistence

open_points.subject: Confirmation binding for erasing audit entries
open_points.text: A15 requires the confirmed audit erasure to have a confirmation id, while A13 rule 6 now permits a confirmation step to have shown no revision only "for a record without a revision (A04 rule 3)". Erasing entries by date has no target record and is not an A04 rule 3 action.
open_points.question: May the audit-erasure confirmation omit the revision/access-version component, and if so what exactly is bound in its place?
options: Bind a distinguished no-version value together with the action and cutoff date.
Treat the audit log or erasure command as a record without a revision.
The changed A13 exception does not cover this action, so its confirmation cannot be formed.
open_points.default_guess: Bind an explicit no-version sentinel together with the action and cutoff date.

witness.initial: The audit log contains entries older than 2026-10-01.
events: The owner requests the confirmation step for erasing entries before 2026-10-01.
The owner submits the displayed confirmation.
outcomes: The versionless confirmation is valid; the old entries are removed and the erasure entry is appended.
The confirmation cannot satisfy A13 because no record revision or access version was shown, so the erasure is refused.

open_points.subject: Confirmation binding for the one-time import
open_points.text: A16 rule 2 says "The owner confirms that mapping in the confirmation step (A13 rule 6)", but A13's new no-revision clause is limited to "a record without a revision (A04 rule 3)". Before acceptance the import has no target record or access version; its file digest and picks are inputs, not a revision.
open_points.question: What occupies the revision/access-version component of an import confirmation, and does A13's no-revision exception cover an action that creates records rather than acting on a revisionless record?
options: Use a distinguished no-version value and bind it with the file digest, picks and mapping inputs.
Regard the migration closure or uploaded file as a record without a revision.
The import confirmation is invalid because the stated exception does not cover it.
open_points.default_guess: Use an explicit no-version sentinel and bind it with the file digest, picks, names, aliases and Customer values.

witness.initial: The store has no migration closure, and owner session S holds a valid uploaded VPS export.
events: The owner selects project P and supplies all required mapping values.
Registry shows the import confirmation step.
The owner submits the matching confirmation.
outcomes: Registry accepts a versionless confirmation and atomically imports P, its related records, the closure and the audit entry.
Registry refuses or cannot issue the confirmation because there is no revisionless target record covered by A13's exception.

open_points.subject: Status of the security review after A04 and A13 changed
open_points.text: A21 rule 2 says "A change to a decision a category names reopens this review." Its review names A13 under authentication_credential_abuse, browser_boundary and concurrency, and A04 under concurrency, yet the unchanged text still says "Security review: PERFORMED" and gives no result of a review of the changes.
open_points.question: Is A21 currently reopened, or was the security review re-performed for the changed A04 and A13 rules; if it was re-performed, what are its resulting category outcomes and references?
options: A21 is reopened and remains incomplete until the changed rules are reviewed.
The review was re-performed and the existing outcomes were reaffirmed.
Only the affected categories are reopened while the other outcomes remain accepted.
open_points.default_guess: Treat the affected categories, and therefore A21's completeness claim, as reopened until an explicit review result is recorded.

witness.initial: A21 is accepted and marked PERFORMED, with concurrency referencing A04 and A13 and other categories referencing A13.
events: A04 is changed to define revision handling for records with no revision.
A13 is changed to allow a confirmation step to show no revision.
outcomes: A21 rule 2 reopens the review, so later work cannot rely on its completeness claim yet.
The unchanged PERFORMED label is treated as still authoritative, so later work relies on the old review without reviewing the new confirmation and ordering behavior.
witness.observer: The security reviewer and later agents deriving code from State 2
